description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) STORM OF DEVASTATION (Gladius Task Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. The shooting panel's unit pick (SELECT_SHOOTER) of the Hellblasters opens unit_selected_to_shoot; a REAL click on the Use button spends 1 CP; their ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER] (the engine's effect_ignores_cover grant) — the Kommandos have Stealth (the benefit of cover), and the resolved shot at them carries no BS worsening.
